source_question: Bounded-Frobenius permanent asymptotics for doubly stochastic matrices.
stronger_theorem_scope: Every nonnegative row-stochastic square matrix of positive integer order.
entrywise_bound: per(A) <= exp(-n + e^4 sum(a_ij^2 log(e/a_ij))); zero terms by continuity.
frobenius_bound: per(A) <= exp(-n + e^4 S(1+log n)), S=sum(a_ij^2).
fixed_gamma_all_n_bound: per(A) <= exp(e^4 gamma) n^(e^4 gamma) exp(-n).
n_equals_one_caveat: The pure-power form without a constant prefactor is false at n=1; the all-n bound retains its prefactor.
source_lower_bound: The already-known van der Waerden bound n!/n^n is credited to prior work and used only for doubly stochastic matrices.
